auth.setupSubtitle: Create the owner account. Only you will be able to sign in.
auth.setupTokenHint: Printed in the hub log when it starts: “Owner setup is open. Setup token: …”
auth.scanSubtitle: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (1Password, Google Authenticator, Aegis…), then enter the 6-digit code.
auth.manualSecret: Can't scan? Enter this key manually

home.commandPlaceholder: e.g. Open Chrome, search for flights to Cairo, save the first result to notes.txt
home.commandSoon: The AI brain arrives in phase 3. Your devices are already connected.
home.noTasksHint: Tasks you give Operator will show up here with their full timeline.
home.noDevicesHint: Pair your first computer to let Operator see and control it.

devices.title: Devices
devices.subtitle: Computers paired with this hub. Agents connect out to the hub, so no ports are opened on your PCs.

permissionHints.view_only: Operator can look but never act.
permissionHints.assisted: Every action waits for your approval.
permissionHints.autonomous: Acts on its own; risky actions still need approval.

devices.name: Device name
devices.removeBody: The agent on this computer will be disconnected immediately and must be paired again to reconnect.
devices.emptyBody: Install the Operator agent on a Windows, macOS or Linux PC and pair it with a one-time code.

pairing.title: Pair a device
pairing.subtitle: Run this on the computer you want to pair.
pairing.step1: Download the agent binary for your OS (or run it from source with pnpm).

placeholder.runs: Watch the agent work step by step: live screen, thoughts, actions and results, with Pause, Stop and Take over.
placeholder.supervisor: Keep coding agents like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor moving until the tests pass.
placeholder.approvals: Risky actions pause here with a screenshot and the exact action for you to approve, reject or edit.
placeholder.providers: Connect Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, local models and subscription CLIs, and pick a model per role.
placeholder.voice: Choose a wake name, speech-to-text and text-to-speech engines, and languages.
placeholder.audit: Every sign-in, pairing and device action is already recorded. Search and export arrive here.

errors.bad_credentials: Email, password or code is incorrect.
errors.bad_code: That code didn't match. Check your authenticator app.
errors.bad_setup_token: Setup token is incorrect. Find it in the hub log.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.pairing_locked: Too many failed pairing attempts. Try again later.
errors.view_only: This device is View only. Raise its permission level to control it.
errors.killed: Operator was stopped on the device. Resume it to continue.

device.stopHint: Block every remote action on this device
device.stoppedBody: Operator was stopped on the device (hotkey, notification or Stop). Nothing can act until you resume.
device.offlineBody: Start the agent on this computer to view and control it.
device.viewOnlyNote: View only: you can watch, but control is off. Raise the permission level to take over.

screen.noDesktop: Screen control isn't available on this device
screen.touchHint: Tap to click · long-press to right-click · drag to drag · two fingers to scroll

terminal.emptyBody: Open a shell on this computer. It keeps running if you close the page.
terminal.unsupported: Terminals aren't supported on this device yet
